rationale: No evidence-supported optimization cleanly applies to this workflow. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence is for pip/Gradle dependency caching with lockfile-hashed keys; this workflow installs protobuf via apt with hardcoded packages and no lockfile, and the apt cache directory requires root access, making the evidenced caching approach inapplicable. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is already the GitHub Actions default (fail-fast defaults to true when unset), and required checks are unverified, so changing matrix cancellation behavior is unsafe. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT evidence uses a 5-minute budget, but observed CI runs take 7-9 minutes, so that limit would cause false failures; no supported basis exists for a different value. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE and P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER require verified required checks and are contraindicated for C++ builds where all source changes can affect the build.
